verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a built-in Vanta AI Agent that works across the platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues, with agentic search and Q&A listed on the pricing page. Task-specific agents (TPRM Agent, an agentic policy generator, agentic questionnaire workflows) back this up. The external MCP server is not credited, because it serves outside assistants rather than providing an in-product one. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how users assign or delegate tasks to the agent and what its scope and limits are, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
